extraction.name: NWPU-RESISC45
extraction.description: A large-scale, freely and publicly available benchmark dataset for remote sensing image scene classification. It contains 31,500 images across 45 scene classes with 700 images per class, and includes large variations in translation, spatial resolution, viewpoint, object pose, illumination, background, and occlusion.
extraction.creator: Northwestern Polytechnical University (NWPU)
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed by first selecting 45 representative scene classes from existing datasets and literature searches, then extracting remote sensing images from Google Earth with expert selection to ensure variation across weather, seasons, illumination, imaging conditions, and scales.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Remote sensing images from Google Earth, which superimposes images obtained from satellite imagery, aerial photography, and geographic information system (GIS) onto a 3D globe.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For the Brazilian coffee scene dataset, agricultural researchers manually identified coffee crops, and tiles were labeled by thresholding the proportion of coffee pixels: at least 85% coffee pixels for the coffee class and less than 10% for the non-coffee class.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may reflect selection bias from expert-curated Google Earth imagery and class design choices, while intentionally including high within-class diversity and between-class similarity that can make some categories semantically overlapping.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The paper discusses limitations of prior datasets rather than explicit shortcomings of NWPU-RESISC45. It notes that scene classification methods generally rely only on overhead imagery, which makes some distinctions difficult and suggests remote sensing images alone may be insufficient for certain tasks.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to support intelligent earth observation applications such as hazard detection, land-use/land-cover determination, environmental monitoring, and urban planning, and the discussion highlights future integration with social media and location-based data for broader geographic knowledge discovery.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Geography/location information is present at aggregate level, since images cover more than 100 countries and regions worldwide.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmark dataset for remote sensing image scene classification, intended to develop, test, and evaluate data-driven algorithms, especially deep learning methods; also used to report performance baselines for future research.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Use of normalization layers in the CNN to improve generalization.
